svg.title: UML class diagram
svg.desc: Twelve application classes, two external classes and their actual implementation relationships.. UML class compartments show names, fields and operations extracted from Archthea's JavaScript source.
svg.text: Twelve application classes, two external classes and their actual implementation relationships.
+ public | - private | get = JavaScript getter | Types describe runtime values.
Hollow triangle: inheritance | Solid arrow: stored reference | Dashed arrow: dependency | 1: one reference
